title: Completion of trajectory recording
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine with Boolean work-tape alphabet, let $x$ and $y$ be Boolean words, and let $T$ be a nonnegative integer. Write $F=2(1+M.k)$ for the number of movement-count fields. Starting with the recorder on physical input $x$, its source machine in the initial state with input $y$, all counts zero, an empty record, clock budget $T$, and logical time zero, there is a number of steps $s$ with $s\le (T+1)(F(3T+4)+2T+7)$ after which the recorder is in its completed control. Its source configuration is the configuration of $M$ after $T$ steps on $y$, its counts are the recursively advanced counts at time $T$, and its record is the concatenation of the encoded rows for times $0$ through $T$; its clock budget and logical time are both $T$, and its physical output is empty.
replaced: For every source machine, physical input, virtual input $y$, and horizon $T$, there is a time $s \le (T+1)(F(3T+4) + 2T + 7)$, where $F$ is the field count, after which the recorder, started from the prepared blank seam, is in its completed live control with the stored rows of all times $0,\dots,T$ on the record tape, the movement counts and the exact horizon configuration of the source, and an empty physical output.
